task:
FIX THE CI-ONLY TEST FAILURE ON PR #793 AND FILL IN THE HOLD FILE'S REVIEW FIELD. Target branch codex/run-37990139541-1, expected head 5b91e3c; fail closed and write nothing if it moved. Only these files may change: tests/test_prod_version_drift.py, deploy/v3-production/promotion-hold.json, tests/test_deploy_drift_contract.py.

ROOT CAUSE (confirmed by a CI annotation on a diagnostic run): tests/test_prod_version_drift.py::test_default_hold_file_is_loaded_relative_to_repo fails in GitHub Actions with 'assert 3 == 0' but passes locally. It calls mod.main(['--repo', str(ROOT), '--main-sha', BASE_MAIN, '--expected-sha', live, '--now-epoch', ...]) against the REAL repository checkout, so main() runs real git: is_ancestor(covers_main_sha, main_sha, repo) and deployable_commits_behind(live, main, repo). The CI checkout is a shallow clone of the PR merge commit (fetch-depth 1), so commits 3b6ee91 and bed755b9 are not present, git merge-base fails and main() returns exit code 3. Locally the full clone has them, so it passes. The test's real purpose is only to prove that, when --hold-file is NOT given, main() loads deploy/v3-production/promotion-hold.json relative to --repo and reports that path.

CHANGE 1 - tests/test_prod_version_drift.py::test_default_hold_file_is_loaded_relative_to_repo. Keep --repo str(ROOT) and the default-path assertion, but remove the dependency on real git exactly the way test_main_classifies_uncovered_commit_and_applies_grace does: monkeypatch mod.deployable_commits_behind to return [] and monkeypatch mod.is_ancestor to a lambda returning True for the (covers_main_sha, main_sha) pair the committed hold file implies, i.e. lambda candidate, descendant, _repo: (candidate, descendant) in {(BASE_MAIN, BASE_MAIN), (live, BASE_MAIN)} (include whichever pairs main() actually checks; read main() and decide() to be sure, and make the set exactly those pairs rather than a blanket True). Add a one-line comment above the monkeypatches: '# CI checks out a shallow PR merge commit, so real git history is unavailable here.' Also assert the output still contains 'Promotion hold file: <ROOT/DEFAULT_HOLD_FILE>' and now additionally assert the hold is reported as active/covering (use whatever first output line main() prints for a fully-covered hold; read the code and assert the exact text).

CHANGE 2 - deploy/v3-production/promotion-hold.json: change "review": "this PR" to "review": "PR #793". Nothing else in that file.

CHANGE 3 - tests/test_deploy_drift_contract.py line ~68: change assert hold["review"] == "this PR" to assert re.fullmatch(r"PR #\d+", hold["review"]) (add import re if missing) so the contract requires a real PR reference rather than a placeholder. If VALID_HOLD in tests/test_prod_version_drift.py or the _hold helper uses "this PR" as a fixture value, leave those alone — they are synthetic fixtures, not the committed file.

VALIDATION (paste commands and counts): 1. python -m pytest tests/test_prod_version_drift.py tests/test_deploy_drift_contract.py -q -p no:cacheprovider  2. Prove the shallow-clone fix: in a temporary directory OUTSIDE the repo run `git clone --depth 1 file://$PWD /tmp/shallow793` (from the repo root, after committing your changes locally), then from inside /tmp/shallow793 run `CI=true python -m pytest tests/test_prod_version_drift.py -q -p no:cacheprovider` and confirm it passes there too; delete /tmp/shallow793 afterwards  3. ruff check tests/test_prod_version_drift.py tests/test_deploy_drift_contract.py  4. python scripts/checks/prod_version_drift.py --help exits 0  5. git diff --name-only 5b91e3c lists only the three allowed files.
